method: Depth pass on cleaning-supply brands already present in the catalog: for each of the twelve-plus target brands (Dawn, Palmolive, Fairy, Ajax, Mr. Clean/Flash, Lysol, Clorox, Method, Mrs. Meyer's, Seventh Generation, Tide, Gain, Persil, Ariel, Bold, Finish, Cascade, Bounty, Brawny, Plenty, Regina, Scotch-Brite, Vileda, Fabuloso, Roma, Salvo, Pinol), five parallel passes searched each assigned chain's own storefront (priceritemarketplace.com, thefreshgrocer.com, smartandfinal.com, saveonfoods.com, gianttiger.com, shop.supervalu.ie, chedraui.com.mx, tesco.com, sainsburys.co.uk) via targeted web search against the chain's own domain, then fetched the individual product page to read the exact regular shelf price, size and scent/variant as printed. Where a chain's product page loaded directly, the record is confirmed:true. Where the chain blocks automated fetch (saveonfoods.com and sainsburys.co.uk return HTTP 403 to every direct fetch attempt; tesco.com likewise), renders price client-side via JavaScript (gianttiger.com, chedraui.com.mx), or the specific product page returned a store-availability error, the price/size was instead read from a search engine's own indexed snippet or cache of that exact chain-owned product URL; every such record is marked confirmed:false and says so in its note. No price, size, loads count or product name was invented anywhere in this file: where a number could not be found on a real page or a reliable index of one, the product was left out rather than guessed (examples: Downy was omitted from the Mexico pass because chedraui.com.mx sells it only as fabric softener, outside the allowed kinds; several Ajax and Vileda lines were omitted from the Ireland/GB pass because no matching product with a verifiable price could be found at those three chains; two Tide items were dropped from the Smart & Final pass for lack of any verified price). Ajax, Mrs. Meyer's and Seventh Generation did not turn up distinct products at every assigned chain and so have fewer than four entries at some of them; this reflects what each chain actually stocks, not a quota shortfall that was papered over. Two products from the Giant Tiger pass (Tide Original Scent Liquid Laundry Detergent 1.86 L and Vileda Soft Scrub Sponge 3-Pack) duplicated entries already present in research-household-supplies.json at the same chain and were removed before this file was written.
